notes: Adds full MiSTer FPGA support with one-click local-network discovery and setup, remote ROM upload and launch, live tracking, and controller restoration after switching games.
Supports both standard MiSTer consoles and MiSTer Multisystem² hardware through the same automatic setup flow.
Adds Game Modes with Play Random Hack, Hack Draft, Difficulty Ladder, Creator Spotlight, Time Capsule, and Hall of Fame Tour.
Adds smart Excel import, two-way Google Sheets synchronization, and clearer Spreadsheet and Google Sheets settings.
Creates a new automatic tracker and database recovery backup on every clean exit so reinstall recovery is safer.
Reworks My Tracker with compact add/remove controls, multi-row removal, automatic Hack # renumbering, and cleaner action menus.
Hides platform-specific setup and settings that do not apply to the selected FXPAK Pro, RetroArch, or MiSTer platform.
Speeds up optional Windows RetroArch setup and keeps RetroArch closed until a game is launched.
Adds Streamer.bot level-event output and translated setup guides for optional Twitch prediction automation.
Updates the MiSTer platform art with the transparent pink-accent cat logo.
Completes all new menus, buttons, statuses, popups, and setup instructions in English, Australian, Spanish, French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese.
Preserves the existing emoji-safe FXPAK mappings, native Apple Silicon and Intel builds, catalog, OBS/LiveSplit tools, blue dialogs, and automatic updater.
